{{Quote|Obi-Wan, Master Tiin, come quickly to the Council Chambers. Something has happened to Masters Plo Koon and Eeth Koth.|Qui-Gon Jinn, following Kenobi's lightsaber duel|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Obredaan]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], to investigate the warriors known as the [[Jin'ha]]. The mission followed [[Skirmishes on Coruscant|efforts]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to avert a war on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that had been sparked by the [[Black Heth]], a criminal gang supplied by the Jin'ha. The Jedi's [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Obredaan)|transport]] was destroyed and the Masters were captured, necessitating a [[Second mission to Obredaan|second Jedi mission]] to the world to discover what had happened.

==Prelude==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Skirmishes on Coruscant|fought]] the [[Black Heth]] criminal gang and [[Jin'ha]] warriors on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="SW:OW" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWE1">{{Film|I}}</ref> He defeated the gang before they could start a war on the planet, and planted a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] on a Jin'ha arms shipment, which the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] tracked to the world [[Obredaan]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] of the warriors.<ref name="SW:OW" /> The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] then sent two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], to Obredaan to investigate the Jin'ha.<ref name="OW guide">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The two Masters [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Obredaan)|''Consular''-class cruiser]] for the mission.<ref name="SW:OW" />

==The mission==
Upon their arrival at Obredaan, Koth's and Koon's [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] crashed into the Obredaan swamps,<ref name="SW:OW" /> and the two Jedi Masters were captured by the Jin'ha.<ref name="CSWE entry">{{CSWECite|II|402|Obredaan}}</ref> Communications between the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] were then cut off.<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|They can't have survived, Master.''"<br />"''No, Padawan. I sense both Jedi somewhere nearby. I will go and find them. I want you to find the Jin'ha facility and discover the source of their weapons technology. We can still turn defeat into victory.|Kenobi and Jinn, after finding the wrecked starship|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
Following the loss of communications, Kenobi's Master, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], summoned the Padawan to the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|Council Chambers]] along with Council member [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], against whom Kenobi had just [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|won]] a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber training duel]] as part of his ongoing [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. The Jedi then sent Kenobi and Jinn to [[Second mission to Obredaan|discover]] what had befallen Koth and Koon. They succeeded in their mission by rescuing the two Masters, and stole a sample of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] metal from a [[Jin'ha cortosis mine|hidden Jin'ha mine]]. Additionally, the arrival of a [[Trade Federation gunship]] at the [[Mining/Legends|mine]] suggested a link between the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the Jin'ha.<ref name="SW:OW" /> Further investigation by Kenobi revealed that the Jin'ha were mining cortosis for the Trade Federation,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|164|Jin'ha}}</ref> and a few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later the Federation betrayed the trust of the Jedi Council by [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockading]] the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Obredaan's first mention was in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']],<ref name="SW:OW" /> which was released on [[December 19]], [[2001]]<ref name="GameDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-obi-wan/reviews/?subTypeId=star&subId=wars-obi-wan-review-2836797|text=''Star Wars: Obi-Wan''}}</ref> It was first mentioned in a preview for the game in a "[[Gamescape]]" article within [[Star Wars Insider 57|''Star Wars Insider'' 57]],<ref name="Insider 57">{{InsiderCite|57|Gamescape}}</ref> published on [[December 4]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2001/10/news20011018.html|text=Bounty Hunters Unmasked In Insider #57}}</ref>
